smsTemplates.name: 30-Day Policy Expiry Reminder
smsTemplates.templateText: Dear [Member Name], your Turihamwe cover with Nyamuyanja SACCO expires on [Expiry Date]. Please renew at [Branch] before the expiry date to maintain your funeral coverage benefits.

smsTemplates.name: 14-Day Expiry Urgent Reminder
smsTemplates.templateText: Reminder: Dear [Member Name], your Turihamwe funeral coverage expires in 14 days on [Expiry Date]. Avoid benefit lapse by renewing at [Branch].

smsTemplates.name: 7-Day Expiry Critical Warning
smsTemplates.templateText: URGENT: Dear [Member Name], 7 days remaining for Turihamwe policy [Policy Code] expiring [Expiry Date]. Renew now at [Branch] or via teller.

smsTemplates.name: Expiry Date Due Notice
smsTemplates.templateText: Dear [Member Name], your Turihamwe coverage expires today [Expiry Date]. Please visit [Branch] immediately to execute your annual renewal.

smsTemplates.name: Claim Submitted Acknowledgement
smsTemplates.templateText: Dear [Member Name], claim docket [Claim Reference] has been received and entered review under [Branch]. You will be updated as review progresses.

smsTemplates.name: Claim Additional Documents Requested
smsTemplates.templateText: Dear [Member Name], additional documents are required to process claim [Claim Reference]. Please deliver requested papers to [Branch].

smsTemplates.name: Claim Approved Notification
smsTemplates.templateText: Dear [Member Name], claim docket [Claim Reference] has been APPROVED. Disbursement processing is underway at [Branch].

smsTemplates.name: Claim Rejection Formal Notification
smsTemplates.templateText: Notice: Claim docket [Claim Reference] could not be approved following policy review. Visit [Branch] for official documented explanation.

smsTemplates.name: Contribution Receipt Notification
smsTemplates.templateText: Nyamuyanja SACCO: Received UGX [Amount UGX] for Turihamwe Account [Account Number]. Receipt Ref: [Receipt Number]. Thank you.
